title: helianthemum croceum subsp. rothmaleri
intro: Helianthemum croceum subsp. rothmaleri, commonly known as Rockrose or Yellow Rockrose, is a flowering plant species in the family Cistaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum croceum subsp. rothmaleri include wound healing, antiseptic, and antiviral activities, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents contribute to the plant's health benefits, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
